Republic of Korea — Tobacco Leaf Producers Cooperative Act [Attached Table] (inserted March 31, 2020)
Scope of customary congratulatory and condolence money and gifts (related to Article 19-3(3)).
The table specifies a generally acceptable monetary limit for each category:
1. Article 19-3(2)(2)(b): Congratulatory or condolence money or gifts provided at weddings, funerals and other ceremonial family occasions — not more than KRW 50,000.
2. Article 19-3(2)(2)(d): Food supplied to guests, mourners or other attendees at weddings, funerals and other celebrations or condolences — not more than KRW 30,000.
3. Article 19-3(2)(2)(d): Return gifts provided to guests, mourners or other attendees at such occasions — not more than KRW 10,000.
4. Article 19-3(2)(2)(r): Customary gifts provided at year-end, Lunar New Year or Chuseok — not more than KRW 30,000.
Source: Korean original annex of KR:001555, edition 276133; monetary amounts are per category. This working translation is not an official legal certification.

metadata.self_review: All four table rows, KRW 50000/30000/10000/30000; linkage to Article 19-3; no qualified legal review
